lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Zn2Sn2 (Mg6ZnSn) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis gives all Mg, Sn, and Zn centers a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors; Mg environments include Mg-only and mixed Mg–Sn/Zn coordination. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts show Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra sharing edges and faces, and Mg–Sn or Mg–Zn polyhedra sharing corners or faces. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 16 sites.
